subject.title: fix(agents): bootstrap non-main models.json on skip to prevent Unknown model after agents.create

question: Should OpenClaw fix the missing non-main `models.json` skip path with sanitized one-time bootstrap from the default agent, read-through inheritance, or an early actionable failure?
rationale: The remaining choice changes provider/auth catalog fallback behavior and upgrade semantics, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Land narrow bootstrap after repair
options.body: Rebase this PR or an equivalent replacement, keep the one-time missing-file bootstrap, and require the stale allowlist fix before merge.

options.title: Prefer read-through inheritance
options.body: Use the adjacent catalog-inheritance direction only if it is extended to cover this missing-root-file case without unsafe provider config mixing.

options.title: Fail early with guidance
options.body: Reject persisted fallback behavior and instead add a clear startup/session error that tells users how to repair the missing per-agent catalog.

recommendation.title: Land narrow bootstrap after repair
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR or an equivalent replacement, keep the one-time missing-file bootstrap, and require the stale allowlist fix before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history for the touched model config and registry paths points to this owner, and the choice spans provider/auth fallback semantics.
